python -c "
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/data.sqlite')
cursor = conn.cursor()

queries = [
'''SELECT
    (SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end = '2024-12-31' AND months = 6 AND measure = 'Total revenue') -
    (SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end = '2024-12-31' AND months = 3 AND measure = 'Total revenue')''',

'''SELECT
    (SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end = '2024-12-31' AND months = 6 AND measure = 'Operating income') -
    (SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end = '2024-12-31' AND months = 3 AND measure = 'Operating income')''',

'''SELECT
    (
        (SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end = '2024-12-31' AND months = 3 AND measure = 'Operating income')
        /
        (SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end = '2024-12-31' AND months = 3 AND measure = 'Total revenue')
        -
        ( (SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end = '2024-12-31' AND months = 6 AND measure = 'Operating income') - (SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end = '2024-12-31' AND months = 3 AND measure = 'Operating income') )
        /
        ( (SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end = '2024-12-31' AND months = 6 AND measure = 'Total revenue') - (SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end = '2024-12-31' AND months = 3 AND measure = 'Total revenue') )
    ) * 10000''',

'''SELECT
    (SELECT constant_currency_percent FROM growth WHERE business = 'Azure and other cloud services')
    -
    (SELECT high FROM guidance WHERE business = 'Azure and other cloud services' AND basis = 'constant_currency')'''
]

for q in queries:
    cursor.execute(q)
    print(cursor.fetchall())
"
